# Ezekiel 7 — The PNEUMA Bible (Dynamic)
**Translator:** PNEUMA | **Source:** Leningrad Codex (B19A)

---

**1** The LORD's message came to me:

**2** "Son of man, this is what the Lord GOD says to the land of Israel: The end! The end has come on all four corners of the land.

**3** The end is here. I am unleashing My anger against you. I will judge you for your behavior and pay you back for all your disgusting sins.

**4** I will show no pity and no mercy. I will repay you for your conduct and the detestable practices among you. Then you will know that I am the LORD."

**5** The Lord GOD says: "Disaster! An unheard-of disaster is coming!

**6** The end has come! The end has come! It has roused itself against you. Here it comes!

**7** Doom has arrived for you who live in this land. The time is here! The day is near! There will be panic on the mountains — not celebration.

**8** Very soon I will pour out My fury on you. I will unleash My full anger against you. I will judge you for the way you've lived and make you pay for all your detestable sins.

**9** I will not spare you. I will not show mercy. I will repay you for your behavior and your disgusting practices. Then you will know that it is I, the LORD, who strikes the blow.

**10** Look! The day is here! Doom has arrived! Wickedness has blossomed. Arrogance is in full bloom.

**11** Look! The day is here! Doom has arrived! Wickedness has blossomed. Arrogance is in full bloom.

**12** Look! The day is here! Doom has arrived! Wickedness has blossomed. Arrogance is in full bloom.

**13** Those who sell their property will never get it back, even if they survive — because this vision of judgment applies to everyone. No one living in sin will hold on to their life.

**14** The trumpet has been blown and everything made ready, but no one goes to battle, because My fury is falling on them all.

**15** Outside the walls, the sword. Inside, disease and famine. If you're in the countryside, you die by the sword. If you're in the city, famine and plague will consume you.

**16** Any survivors will flee to the mountains, moaning like doves in the valleys — each one grieving over their own sins.

**17** Any survivors will flee to the mountains, moaning like doves in the valleys — each one grieving over their own sins.

**18** Any survivors will flee to the mountains, moaning like doves in the valleys — each one grieving over their own sins.

**19** Any survivors will flee to the mountains, moaning like doves in the valleys — each one grieving over their own sins.

**20** They took their beautiful jewelry and used it to make their vile idols and disgusting images. So I will turn their treasures into something repulsive.

**21** I will hand it all over to foreigners as plunder and to the wicked of the earth as loot. They will desecrate it.

**22** I will look away while they desecrate My precious Temple. Thugs will march in and defile it.

**23** Forge chains for captivity! The land is drenched in bloodshed, and the city is overflowing with violence.

**24** I will bring the most brutal nations to seize their homes. I will crush the pride of the powerful, and their sacred places will be defiled.

**25** Terror is coming! They will desperately seek peace, but there will be none.

**26** One catastrophe will follow another, rumor after rumor. They will beg prophets for a vision. The priests will have no instruction. The elders will have no advice.

**27** The king will mourn. The prince will be clothed in despair. The common people's hands will tremble with fear. I will treat them the way they have treated others and judge them the way they have judged. Then they will know that I am the LORD."

---
## PNEUMA's Meaning Notes

- **7:2-6**: The word 'end' gets hammered again and again — God is making sure nobody misses it. This isn't a warning about something far off. This is 'the end is HERE.'

- **7:19**: Money becomes worthless in the day of God's judgment. All the silver and gold in the world can't buy your way out. That's a message as relevant today as it was then.

- **7:26**: When prophets have no visions, priests have no teaching, and elders have no wisdom — society is in total freefall. God's greatest judgment may not be fire from heaven but simply silence.

— PNEUMA
